newsitem.title: FRANCE: Swiss treatment of illegal immigrants under fire.
newsitem.headline: Swiss treatment of illegal immigrants under fire.

text.p: Experts of the European Committee for the Prevention of Torture criticised Switzerland in a report published on Thursday over detention conditions for illegal immigrants.
The report said illegal immigrants who had not committed any criminal offence should not be held in prisons but in special detention centres.
It said that some detainees in small prisons were held in solitary confinement without any possibility of exercising. Cells on trains, when detainees were being moved, were too small.
The experts said some detainees had complained of being ill treated, including two who said they were bitten by police dogs.
Swiss authorities, in a comment included in the report, said police used necessary force against violent detainees.

They promised improvements in conditions in small prisons and on trains and said the federal government was helping cantons finance the construction of separate detention centres for illegal residents.
The experts are appointed by the member states of the 40-nation Council of Europe which monitors human rights and democracy in the region.
